b'# tinydl

A minimal command-line tool for downloading files from URLs.

## Usage

```
tinydl <url> [options]
```

## Command Line Options

| Option | Help Text |
|--------|-----------|
| `url` | what to download |
| `-o, --output <file>` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q, --quiet` | no progress output |

## Examples

Download a file and print it to stdout:

```
tinydl https://example.com/file.txt
```

Save to a file:

```
tinydl https://example.com/file.txt -o file.txt
```

Quiet mode (suppresses the byte count):

```
tinydl https://example.com/file.txt -q -o file.txt
```
'
